question: Can the transferred pitched/harmonic method scan a complete controlled mix without event locations and recover a useful subset of Bass observations missed by frozen htdemucs_ft-to-JGA with bounded false-candidate burden?

candidate_firewall.ordering: two canonical candidate streams must be byte-identical, hashed and committed before evaluator execution

transferred_frontend.rate_adaptation: deterministic scipy.signal.resample_poly 147/160 from native 48 kHz to transferred 44.1 kHz analysis rate

transferred_pitch_method.candidate_set: up to 3 aggregate local maxima at least 35 cents apart and >=95% of best score

continuous_event_formation.scan_hop: every 1024 analysis samples from sample zero
continuous_event_formation.eligible_frame: transferred >=3 supported partials and harmonic-energy ratio >=0.12
continuous_event_formation.track_link: successive eligible frames separated by no more than two intervening ineligible frames and best F0 change <=70 cents
continuous_event_formation.activation: at least 3 eligible linked frames, including 3 consecutive scan frames spanning <=35 cents
continuous_event_formation.timestamp: analysis-time start of the first frame in the earliest qualifying stable triple
continuous_event_formation.persistence: first through last eligible linked frame including one frame duration
continuous_event_formation.pitch_change: >70 cents terminates the old track; a new track must independently activate
continuous_event_formation.ambiguity: retain up to 3 aggregate F0 candidates under transferred 95% rule
continuous_event_formation.duplicate_suppression: for candidate timestamps <120 ms apart retain the candidate with more eligible frames, then higher aggregate best score, then earlier timestamp

temporal_evaluation.matching: global greedy one-to-one edges within +/-50 ms ordered by absolute displacement, then earlier candidate timestamp, original timestamp, candidate ID, original ID
temporal_evaluation.f1_any_original: precision and all-original scanner recall harmonic mean

pitch_evaluation.reference: only after candidate lock, apply transferred +40 to +300 ms event-centered method independently to original Bass audio
pitch_evaluation.agreement: minimum candidate/reference error <=50 cents without octave folding
pitch_evaluation.limitation: isolated Bass microphone plus estimator is a pitch proxy, not symbolic note or physical-onset Ground Truth

uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for proportions; descriptive displacement median, quartiles, RMSE and maximum

decision_gates.USEFUL: all invariants and replay pass; missed recall >=0.15; candidate precision >=0.30; unmatched/newly-recovered ratio <=2; median absolute timing displacement <=0.025 s; at least 50% of temporally matched missed events pitch-evaluable and pitch-compatible proportion >=0.50
decision_gates.PARTIAL: all invariants and replay pass; missed recall >=0.05; candidate precision >=0.15; unmatched/newly-recovered ratio <=5; median absolute timing displacement <=0.040 s; at least 50% of temporally matched missed events pitch-evaluable and pitch-compatible proportion >=0.25; without meeting USEFUL
decision_gates.INSUFFICIENT: all authority, ordering, execution and replay invariants pass but PARTIAL is not met
decision_gates.INDETERMINATE: an authority, firewall ordering, execution or deterministic replay invariant fails, or, when at least one missed event is temporally matched, fewer than 50% are pitch-evaluable

negative_control: all candidates unmatched to any original Bass within the frozen tolerance form the omnibus full-mix false-candidate burden; no other source is removed or used during generation
interpretation_firewall: No physical-onset Ground Truth, unique Double Bass source attribution, complete transcription, causal masking, groove/swing, beat/meter, production readiness, autonomous JGA recovery, or authorized union claim.

software.environment: isolated temporary venv referencing unchanged frozen packages; no installation
